body.name: ItemTraxx suspicious query tripwire
body.description: Challenge obvious injection and traversal probes on ItemTraxx edge APIs.

rules.expression: http.host eq "edge.itemtraxx.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/rest/v1/items" "/functions/admin-item-mutate" "/functions/admin-ops"}) and (lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "<script" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "%3cscript" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "union%20select" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "union+select" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "../" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "%2e%2e%2f" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "%252e%252e%252f")
rules.description: Challenge common injection and path traversal probes on auth, item search, and admin routes.

body.description: ItemTraxx sensitive auth and search: 60 requests per client per 60 seconds
body.expression: http.host eq "edge.itemtraxx.com" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/") or http.request.uri.path in {"/rest/v1/items" "/rest/v1/item_status_history" "/rest/v1/item_logs" "/rest/v1/item_access_grants" "/functions/admin-item-mutate" "/functions/admin-ops" "/functions/security-audit"})

logpush_firewall_events.redaction: Do not include ClientRequestQuery, Cookie, Authorization, or UserAgent fields. The bridge HMAC-hashes ClientIP before PostHog event capture.

deployment_notes: Read both phase entrypoint rulesets first and append rules; do not replace existing rules.
Rate-limit rules are appended last in the http_ratelimit entrypoint ruleset.
The custom ruleset has no effect until an execute rule is added to the http_request_firewall_custom entrypoint.
Validate expression support and rate-limiting entitlements for the current Cloudflare plan before enabling.
Start the challenge rule in Log mode on a test hostname, then enable managed_challenge after reviewing false positives.
